statement: The unrestricted D_m notation is not an intrinsic Johnson homomorphism; the correctly filtered Johnson map is injective and special on boundary-fixing automorphisms.
notes: An expansion is required for arbitrary homogeneous logarithmic terms; actual graded images use A_m/A_{m+1}.

notes: The bracket map is integrally surjective, so all ambient modules are finite free.

notes: The lattice-eigenbasis determinant and Nakamura2013 p492 correction of 1995 (3.11.4) are retained: 12 kappa_11=d chiell22, so b0=-d chi_2^(4)/48. Polylogarithm specialization sources are checked without inferring nonvanishing from a syntomic formula alone.

statement: Every multihomogeneous special derivation with nonzero metabelian image has constants exactly the boundary line; this includes each epsilon_m and T.
notes: Complete free-Lie/Lazard proof; marked-letter substitutions are injective by least left-word length, eliminating cancellation.

statement: At split primes the actual rational graded Delta image contains an unbounded family of extreme epsilon derivations.
notes: The inner degree2 term is removed explicitly; no freeness conjecture is invoked.

notes: Nonzero metabelian arithmetic derivations exist at every prime; CM Frobenius projectors extract one weight. This is a full pro-ell assertion, not only finite-class fixed layers.

manuscript_passages: G(d); CK E2; LM3b D.5; LM section34 scan483
notes: The sole nonzero b0 is sufficient: T(x) is not in [x,L4]. Class4 logarithmic denominators are units at5.

manuscript_passages: G(d); LM3b D.4; LM section34 scan483
notes: Finite-cover detection forces first degree1 or2 by Frobenius weights. Inert/2 homology is irreducible; split eigenlines have the degree4 obstruction.

statement: At every prime, a procyclic subgroup of P_ell with open arithmetic normalizer is conjugate into actual inertia.
notes: The degree2 first term forces the power character to be exactly cyclotomic, including on the geometric kernel.

notes: All lower-degree brackets at14 have rank153, versus147 from even degrees only. CM bracket maps at10,12,14 are injective.

notes: Uses an explicitly labelled opened2026 preprint. Its arithmetic hypotheses are independently verified; no unbounded freeness assumption. Standard genuine action adds central degree2.

statement: The actual rational arithmetic (3,3) line in degree6 is spanned by V6=([F,[F,epsilon6]]-192Z3)/6; its coefficient is chi3/1536. The full degree6 rational embedding is explicit.
depends_on: HainMatsumoto2020, sections6-7 and20-22, Proposition29.1 and Corollary29.2
notes: The universal constant mixed Tate quotient identifies the invariant coefficient at every smooth fibre; the geometric coefficient is computed separately from the corrected raw theta character. W and relative M are distinguished: both the W-degree4 Tate component and W-degree6 invariant component come from the same one-dimensional M-weight6 source; only the quotient coefficient is transported. Exact boundary, SL2, metabelian, Pollack-tree and defining-Tate-equation checks pass. No integral image index is claimed.

statement: Exact embedded generator coordinates beyond degree6 and their integral arithmetic indices are not all determined. The degree8 middle line is reduced to one unique unknown scalar lambda in A8+lambda B8.

statement: Full profinite fixed subgroups and undetected procyclic normalizers remain undecided; their precise residual cases lie in the common kernel of all maximal pro-ell quotients.
